backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and boolean responses with strict access control for users and admins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature mapping file linking implemented features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend component in the Valentine's app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styling defining Valentine‑themed OKLCH colors, dark mode values, and base utility application.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React main.tsx bundle into the root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling YES/NO interactions, routing to results, animations, and background/music integration.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Generates randomized floating heart particles that animate upward during YES celebrations.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays a themed footer with ©2026 text, a pulsing heart icon, and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Robust audio player with autoplay detection, play/pause control, volume handling, and fallback track logic.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCarousel.ts: Carousel showing three romantic photos with captions using shadcn carousel components.
Interactive Valentine proposal UI with growing Yes button, shrinking No button, and rotating prompts on No clicks.
frontend/src/components/SadHeartAnimatio: Displays a centered bouncing sad-heart image overlay for emotional feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, including login, logout, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for submitting responses, fetching all responses, and checking admin status via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind config plus custom animations and theme variables for hearts, flashing prompts, and dark mode.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx: Admin-only results view showing stored responses with loading, access control, and formatted UI states.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routing) and persisting them in sessionStorage, plus utilities to clear parameters from session state or the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing the Valentine proposal site, its architecture notes, issues, and a list of existing feature tasks with versioned requirements.
